row:
Welcome to the Oak Creek Small Animal Clinic YouTube Channel. 

We are a full-service and award-winning animal clinic specializing in a wide-array of veterinary care for dogs, cats, reptiles, avian and exotic animals. Our animal clinic is located in a new state-of-the-art facility in West Sedona, Arizona.

Oak Creek Small Animal Clinic has been serving the pets of the Verde Valley since 2003. Offering comprehensive preventative care, pet wellness programs, online pharmacy, internal medicine, water treadmill therapy, Aspen laser therapy, oncology, chemotherapy, advanced dentistry, pain management, anesthesia, as well as elective, routine, and major surgery. Financing and transportation available to all pets of the Verde Valley.
